text:
Jon Park: Heads up — NexSilicon EAP kickoff request landed. They want a short pilot: 2-day lab run, NDA tweaks, and a joint readout. Can we assemble owners?
Maya Singh: I can own the bench run and test vectors. Proposed targets: p95/p99, throughput at batch sizes 1/8/32, and a 30-minute stability soak. Models: redwood/base-1.5b, redwood/opt-7b.
DevOpsBot: Lab slots available: 2026-07-08 08:00-12:00 PT and 2026-07-09 08:00-12:00 PT. Reserved tentative until NDA signed.
Jon Park: Good. Legal on NDA? They redlined telemetry and publication clauses.
LegalBot: Reviewed redline. Flagging telemetry retention removal and a publication approval window of 90 days. Recommend counter: 45-day retention for telemetry, carve-outs for incident response, and explicit embargo terms.
Maya Singh: For perf collection they can provide aggregated power and group CPU/GPU utilization. They cannot share per-core frequencies. That's ok for our dashboards.
BenchBot: Suggested run config: models=redwood/base-1.5b,redwood/opt-7b; quant=8bit; batches=1,8,32; seq=128,512; profile=kvcache,mem,power; soak=1800s.
Jon Park: MarketingOps: hold any marketplace listing or partner naming until countersign and PR approval.
MarketingOps: Copy that. No external mention until approved.
Maya Singh: I'll include KV-cache warmup sweep and a microburst trace test (burst window 5s every 60s). Add flag `--microburst=true`.
DevOpsBot: Please validate network: RDMA + S3 access required. Run validation by EOD.
Jon Park: Next steps: Legal to upload counter NDA today, Maya to push bench scripts and validation, DevOps to confirm lab reachability. Once NDA signed we confirm slot and send partner run plan.
LegalBot: Counter-NDA uploaded: https://redwood.share/nda/nexsilicon-counter-v1.pdf. Key points: 45-day telemetry retention, embargo 60 days for public materials, data ingest controls.
BenchBot: Canary job scheduled: 2026-07-07T20:00Z. Main run: 2026-07-08T15:00Z.
Maya Singh: Pushed scripts to repo and tagged `eap/nexsilicon/v1`. Runbook link: https://redwood.share/runs/nexsilicon-eap-runbook.md
Jon Park: Thanks. Partner requested a 30-min post-run readout. Tentative: 2026-07-09 11:30 PT.
MarketingOps: Will prepare redacted dashboard templates and a non-branded summary slide.
Jon Park: Perfect. Ping here if blockers pop up. :thumbsup:
